description: D. Babynona v. Charlet Vinifreeda Fonseka D. Babynona v. Charlet Vinifreeda Fonseka View More before Hon. Anil Gooneratne, J.
parties: D. Babynona v. Charlet Vinifreeda Fonseka D. Babynona v. Charlet Vinifreeda Fonseka View More
keywords: Plaintiff sought recovery of possession of premises, claiming forcible dispossession. District Court dismissed the action, finding the Plaintiff failed to establish possession. A prior action had only awarded damages, not possession to the Plaintiff. Held - Court found no cogent reason to disturb the trial judge\'s findings that the Plaintiff had not proved possession. Appeal dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
